瑞士 · Genève · 45 所有城市與市鎮

Canton of Geneva (Genève) — 瑞士旅遊指南：必去景點、交通方式與在地美食

Jet d'Eau & Lake Geneva harbor, Vieille Ville & St. Pierre Cathedral, Palais des Nations & CERN Science Gateway, Carouge bohemian quarter. Geneva Airport (GVA) is 7 minutes by free train from Genève-Cornavin station; TGV Lyria to Paris.

所屬地區 / 州份Canton of Geneva (Genève)
主要交通樞紐Geneva Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)
所有城市與市鎮45

交通方式與當地移動

Geneva Airport (GVA) is 7 minutes by free train from Genève-Cornavin station; TGV Lyria to Paris.

在地美食與特產

  • Filets de perche
  • Longeole sausage
  • Cardons épineux genevois
  • Artisanal Swiss watchmakers' cafés & chocolatiers
